text:
anya (recruiter): Quick scheduling Q — Tanya Gomez (L4 SWE) has a hybrid loop next Wed. Candidate flagged childcare constraints and asked for an earlier window (needs to leave by 3:00pm PT). Plan: remote coding exercise + in-office panel. Can we shift panel earlier and arrange parking + loaner laptop?

tom w (hiring mgr): 1:00–3:00pm PT would work for the panel on our side. Can interviewers make 12:00pm remote coding + 1:00pm on-site? @lina chen?

lina chen: 12:00 remote + 1:00 onsite works for me. prefer to end strict by 3pm since debriefs pile up.

samir (people-ops): We can do parking pass + lunch voucher. I'll prep the visitor logistics email and expense guidance. @it-support-bot can you reserve a loaner MacBook (USB-C) with standard image + a local account?

it-support-bot: Loaner MacBook reserved (hold: 1). Need candidate full legal name + phone number to attach to reservation. Provisioning ETA: 24h before visit. Charger included. 

anya (recruiter): Sending candidate the proposal now: remote coding at 12:00pm PT, in-office panel 1:00–3:00pm. Candidate accepted the earlier window and reiterated must leave by 3:00pm. Please ensure parking cover from 12:45–15:30 and a quiet interview room. @facilities-bot @care-team

facilities-bot: Parking confirmed: Visitor spot B12 reserved for Tanya Gomez from 12:45–15:30. Visitor badge will be pre-printed — front desk to hand off. Please provide full name/company to finalize. Quiet room (Conf D) blocked for the panel.

samir (people-ops): I'll generate an event logistics doc and lunch voucher ($25). Expense note: rideshare or transit reimbursable — receipts to expenses@redwood.com, use project code HIRING-REIMB. I'll DM candidate the form link.

tom w (hiring mgr): Two quick asks: 1) Add a short note in the calendar invite: "Candidate needs to leave by 3pm — please keep debriefs concise." 2) Add Zoom fallback and turn off recording.

lina chen: A couple items from interviewers: bring a whiteboard marker + eraser, and avoid multi-hour deep dives since candidate has time limit. I'll keep my segment to 25m.

anya (recruiter): Candidate details for provisioning: Tanya Gomez, phone 415-555-0199, pronouns she/her. I'll send invites and the logistics doc: https://redwood-internal/link/candidate-logistics (internal).

it-support-bot: Provisioning started. Loaner will be imaged with standard interview profile; pickup at reception on arrival.

samir (people-ops): Accessibility/care note — candidate asked for quieter room and a shorter break between sessions. Tagging @care-team to confirm accommodations.

care-team: Noted — quiet room confirmed (Conf D). We'll put a "quiet interview" sign outside and let reception know to avoid overhead announcements.

anya (recruiter): All invites sent: remote session 2026-05-06 12:00–12:50 PT (Zoom), onsite panel 2026-05-06 13:00–15:00 PT (Conf D). Added note about early departure and expense instructions. Thanks everyone :tada:

tom w (hiring mgr): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

lina chen: Got it. See you all then.

samir (people-ops): I'll upload the voucher and expense template to the invite.

anya (recruiter): Candidate confirmed receipt and said she'll bring a laptop just in case but will use the loaner if needed. Posting final checklist here:
- Parking B12 reserved
- Loaner MacBook reserved (pickup at reception)
- Quiet room (Conf D) blocked
- Lunch voucher $25 + expense instructions in invite
- Calendar invites + Zoom fallback sent

anya (recruiter): Closing thread — will reopen if anything changes.
